source: US FDA Daily Values for adults and children aged 4 and over, as used on the Nutrition Facts label (21 CFR 101.9).
note: These are US reference values. EU Reference Intakes differ for several nutrients, and no single set is right everywhere — so the nutrition panel labels the column as US Daily Values rather than presenting it as a universal figure. A nutrient absent from this table has no established Daily Value and its %DV column is omitted rather than computed against an invented denominator. Total sugars is the notable case: the FDA sets a Daily Value for added sugars only, and Xefy does not distinguish added from intrinsic sugars, so no percentage is shown for it.

noDailyValue.sugars: The FDA sets a Daily Value for added sugars only, which this data cannot separate from intrinsic sugars.
noDailyValue.transFat: No Daily Value established; the guidance is to keep intake as low as possible.
